messages:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-0532 - Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts on /v1/generate. Region: us-west-1. Triggered by spike at 11:03UTC. Severity: P1.
ops-bot: Incident channel created -> #inc-2537779999. Runbook: /runbooks/batching-backpressure.md.
mike_oncall: I'm looking at the dashboard now. 5xxs are mostly 502/504 gateway errors, and total latency jumps from 120ms -> 2.3s. Queue depth on batcher-scheduler shows steady ramp.
julie_sre: Confirmed. Batcher queue depth: ~18k ops, head_of_line_waiters showing >9s p95. KV cache hit rate dropped ~15%.
mike_oncall: @devin_platform can you check scheduler daemon logs on usw1-batcher-0/1? suspecting backpressure miscalc after last deploy.
devin_platform: pulling logs. Seeing `BatchingScheduler::enqueue` errors: "QueueFullException" followed by retries. Also intermittent `kv_cache_miss` spikes. Posting snippet: ```ERROR 11:05:32 scheduler.cc enqueue failed: QueueFullException queue_size=17988 max=16384
ERROR 11:05:42 gateway.cc upstream timeout to model-backend-4 504```
emily_prod: CS got first inbound customer reports ~11:06UTC - high latency/timeouts for generation endpoints. Tier1 flagged enterprise customers. Severity = degraded for ~7 customers. Sam is coordinating.
sam_support: Noted. Reached out to top3 affected customers with templated message. No escalations yet but one support ticket opened.
kevin_engineer: Copy — on a quick triage, the scheduler is aggregating too aggressively. Batch formation timeout is 800ms; increasing batch timeout to 1200ms may reduce head-of-line blocking but could raise p99. Suggest immediate mitigation = reduce max_batch_size and scale up worker-count.
julie_sre: Mitigations list: 1) Route new traffic to fallback model variant (smaller model) 2) Increase scheduler concurrency on pool-usw1 3) Temporarily reduce batch_time_ms and max_batch_size 4) Purge stale queued requests (eviction). Which do we want as first action?
mike_oncall: Do #1 + #2 in parallel. Devin, can you start a scaled-up replica set for batcher-pool-usw1 (x2)? I'll open a routing override to fallback-model-small for non-SLA traffic.
devin_platform: K8s scale initiated: batcher-pool-usw1 deployment replicas 6 -> 12. Rolling up nodes. ETA ~2m.
ops-bot: Deploybot: routing override applied: /v1/generate -> fallback-model-small for route tag = non-sla. Old route preserved as fallback.
julie_sre: While scaling, I'm going to evict long-waiting entries older than 6s to reduce HOL. Running eviction script now: ```python3 tools/evict_queue.py --age-threshold 6 --pool usw1```
mike_oncall: Good. After evictions, monitor error-rate and p50/p95. If 5xx drops below 1%, we'll keep scaling and slowly revert routing.
devin_platform: Scale finished. New pods registered, readiness passing. CPU spike but stable.
kevin_engineer: After eviction and scale, observed request throughput increase ~18%. 5xx rate down from 12% -> 3.2% in last 60s. KV cache warming back up.
emily_prod: Notifying customers: update sent. CS will send another note in 10m.
sam_support: One enterprise customer requested SLA credit guidance — sending internal runbook link to finance for assessment.
julie_sre: Next step: tune scheduler config to avoid regressing. We'll reduce `max_batch_size` from 256 -> 128 and lower `batch_delay_ms` from 800 -> 400 in a canary on 10% of traffic. Will trigger via rollout policy.
mike_oncall: Apply canary on a single node pool then monitor for 5m. If stable, roll to all. I'll stay with primary until handoff.
ops-bot: Incident timeline note: page triggered 11:03UTC, mitigation actions executed 11:07-11:11UTC (routing + scale + eviction), measurable improvement by 11:13UTC.
kevin_engineer: Root cause hypothesis: recent change to batching heuristics (PR#5214) interacted poorly with KV cache eviction under memory pressure, causing batch formation stalls -> HOL blocking -> gateway upstream timeouts.
devin_platform: Captured core logs and opened internal issue: RED-3456. Attaching logs and memstats.
mike_oncall: Ok team, I'll hand off to @oncall-next for ongoing review and RCA. Summary to include customer impact, mitigation steps, timeline, and next actions (rollback PR#5214 or patch heuristics).
oncall-next: taking over. I'll keep the channel open and coordinate RCA. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD UTC. Please add any remaining notes to the incident doc. :memo: 
ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 11:22UTC — 5xx stable <1% and key customers reconnected.
emily_prod: CS confirms affected customers have been briefed; one follow-up call scheduled.
kevin_engineer: leaving a note: re-run load tests with simulated KV pressure and new batching config prior to any rollout.
mike_oncall: Thanks all — good quick triage. Closing live page. Leaving monitoring alerts at elevated sensitivity for next 2 hours.
